page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.gn5i-c16g1.4xlarge is a GPU-accelerated cloud instance powered by the KVM hypervisor on an x86_64 CPU architecture. The instance is configured with 16 dedicated vCPUs and 64 GB of system memory, yielding a ratio of 4 GB RAM per vCPU core. Hardware acceleration is provided by a single integrated NVIDIA P4 GPU equipped with 8 GB of VRAM. Baseline network bandwidth is rated at 3 Gbps, and no local NVMe or SSD storage is attached directly to the host.

The primary architectural tradeoff of the instance is the absence of local ephemeral storage, requiring network-attached storage solutions for persistent data needs. With a balance of 16 compute cores, 64 GB memory, and an entry-level inference GPU, the instance provides cost efficiency for GPU-assisted compute density without allocating top-tier enterprise GPU hardware. The instance is suited for AI inference, light machine learning model serving, video transcoding, and media processing workloads.
description: Alibaba Cloud ecs.gn5i-c16g1.4xlarge is a GPU-accelerated instance built on an x86_64 architecture using KVM virtualization. It features 16 dedicated vCPUs, 64 GB of RAM, and a single NVIDIA P4 GPU with 8 GB of VRAM. The system provides 3 Gbps of baseline network bandwidth and includes no local ephemeral storage, relying entirely on network storage for persistent volumes. The 4 GB per vCPU ratio combined with discrete GPU acceleration delivers a balanced hardware profile for compute workloads requiring dedicated GPU assistance. The absence of local disk drives trades local I/O throughput for simplified instance scaling and deployment flexibility. This instance is suited for AI inference tasks, video encoding and transcoding pipelines, lightweight computer vision processing, and general GPU-assisted web application serving.
